title: Qwen edit (qwen/edit/spec/**/*.json)
description: One illustration request per JSON file under qwen/edit/spec/, including subfolders. The path relative to qwen/edit/spec/ without .json is the spec id. ComfyUI filename_prefix is that id (nested folders preserved). Character reference image plus a natural-language instruction for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511; not Animagine tag arrays. Output size follows the first reference image; image_size is not used.

images.description: Reference image paths, one to three. Output size follows the first image. When using more than one, name their roles in prompt (Image 1, Image 2, Image 3). Resolved relative to the process working directory when not absolute.

prompt.description: Illustration instruction sent to ComfyUI as-is. Prose, not tag arrays. example.json is a fill-in template; brace placeholders are not expanded, so replace them (or omit unused change sentences) before generating. Image 1 is the full-body reference (body proportions, clothing, hair); Image 2 is the face close-up (facial features only). Keep remaining attributes. Change person attributes (expression, pose). Place / Use cover scene, camera, and lighting. Change the art style to {Style} is last; omit that sentence to keep Image 1's drawing style. Do not Keep art style from Image 1 in the same prompt. Replace is for swapping objects, not pose. Do not put Do not instructions in prompt or negative; Qwen-Image-Edit has no official semantic negative, and a Do not sentence in negative can encode as the thing to avoid. Optional quality phrases (e.g. Ultra HD, 4K, cinematic composition) go after Style. Placeholder values should fit the verbs (a slight smile, standing, a quiet street, a full shot from the front, natural light, ink-wash watercolor), not LoRA slot prefixes (with/in/as).

negative.description: Optional negative prompt. Natural language. The Qwen-Image-Edit official unused value is a single space in example.json. Omit when unused; ComfyUI then receives a single space. There is no official semantic default. Has little effect when CFG is 1.
